description: What the main window may call. One file, where there were two: a permission naming a plugin that was not in the mobile binary would not resolve, so what a computer alone could call had to be named apart. This application is built for Windows, macOS and Linux and for nothing else, so there is one binary, one set of plugins and no platform to name. `dialog` and `updater` are among them and are called by nothing — see `src/lib.rs`.
